payload.core_mechanism_summary: Performs LSD radix sort by iterating from last character to first, sorting ascending on even-indexed positions and descending on odd-indexed positions using stable sort.
payload.rationale: The code uses multiple stable sorts per character position to achieve the specified odd-even lexicographic order, which is a radix sort approach, not a single custom key sort. However, the closest subtype is sorting_custom_key.
